blocks.text: Security threats ke asar sangeen ho sakte hain. Spam aksar sirf ek nuisance (tang karne wali cheez) hai, lekin spyware aap ka personal data chura kar privacy ke bare masail paida kar sakta hai. Cookies aap ki online activities track kar ke aap ki privacy mein dakhal de sakti hain. Phishing aur pharming financial losses (paison ka nuqsan) kar sakti hain aur doosron ko aap ke accounts tak unauthorized (baghair ijazat) rasai de sakti hain. In khatron ka asar kam ya zyada ho sakta hai, magar sab aap ki hifazat aur privacy ko mutasir karte hain. Masail se bachne aur personal maloomat mehfooz rakhne ke liye in khatron ka ilm zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: 90% se zyada phishing attacks email ke zariye hote hain. Yeh scams aksar bharose wale idaron ke asli paighamat jaise lagte hain, is liye kisi link par click karne ya personal maloomat dene se pehle bhejne wale (source) ki tasdeeq karna bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Spam, cookies aur phishing ko kam se zyada sangeen ki tarteeb mein rakhein, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Spam (aksar sirf tang karta hai), cookies (online activities track kar ke privacy mein dakhal), phishing (paison ka nuqsan aur accounts tak baghair ijazat rasai).

items: Spam: nuisance; spyware: data chori; cookies: tracking; phishing aur pharming: paison ka nuqsan aur accounts tak rasai.
90% se zyada phishing email se hoti hai; link se pehle source check karein.
